pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0136 preview residency and streaming
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements project-scoped preview CPU/GPU residency, asynchronous preview renderer warm-up, frame-budgeted GPU uploads, atomic reimport promotion, startup stale-catalog recovery, and ADR 0135 reclaim recovery for ADR 0136.

Adds deterministic verification for same-generation deduplication and GPU reclaim, and fixes the remaining affected clippy diagnostic.
